scores.label: A
scores.note: Option 1 is 0: drops 'when we exercise', the condition the sentence and paragraph need, so the claim is about hearts in general. 2 is clean and shorter. 3 is awkward with a dangling 'pumping'; 4 is barely shorter and passive; 5 is stiff ('extra oxygen supply').

scores.label: B
scores.note: 3 keeps every fact (hearts, exercise, blood, oxygen) in fewer words; 4 is clean. 1 and 5 say 'exercise pumps' blood (mis-assigns the heart's role), 5 repeats 'extra'; 2 'adding extra' is redundant. Options are near copies of one another.
